name: How long does it take to design and build a multigenerational living solution?
description: Design and permitting can take 3-6 months, while construction typically ranges from 4-12 months, for a total of 8-18 months.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to design and build a multigenerational living solution?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for designing and building a multigenerational living solution varies based on the project's scope, from renovating an existing space to new ADU construction. Design and permitting can take several months, often 3-6 months, depending on city review times. Construction itself typically ranges from 4 to 12 months, influenced by factors like material availability, weather, and project complexity. A realistic total timeframe usually spans from 8 to 18 months from initial design to completion.
